title: A relative Proj of a finite type graded algebra is of finite type
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if A is of finite type as a sheaf of O_S-algebras, then the relative Proj p : Proj_S(A) -> S is of finite type and O_X(d) is a finite type O_X-module (source lines 7688-7696). The proof uses quasi-compactness from the preceding lemma to reduce to local finite typeness, passes to S affine with A a finite type R-algebra, and observes that X is glued from the spectra of the rings A_(f) for homogeneous f in A_+, each of which is of finite type over R by the dehomogenisation lemma; the statement about the twists uses the second part of the same algebra lemma.
